definition: תְּכוּנָה noun feminine arrangement, preparation, fixed place ; — 1. arrangement, disposition תְּכוּנָתוֺ Ezek 43:11 , i.e. the arrangement of the house (strike out Co with ᵐ5 Manuscripts) 2. preparation , וְאֵין קֶצֶה לַתְּכוּנָה Nah 2:10 and no end to the preparation (i.e. things prepared, supply, store). 3. fixed place , i.e. dwelling-place, of God (= מָכוֺן ) תְּכוּנָתוֺ Job 23:3 .

BDB3953 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB3955

תְּכוּנָה noun feminine arrangement, preparation, fixed place; —

1. arrangement, disposition תְּכוּנָתוֺ Ezek 43:11, i.e. the arrangement of the house (strike out Co with ᵐ5 Manuscripts)
2. preparation, וְאֵין קֶצֶה לַתְּכוּנָה Nah 2:10 and no end to the preparation (i.e. things prepared, supply, store).
3. fixed place, i.e. dwelling-place, of God (= מָכוֺן) תְּכוּנָתוֺ Job 23:3.
